environment: Disposable Debian 13 x86_64 VM on home-lab worker; official Codex 0.167.2; gpt-5.6-sol; native auto mode

cases.before: Exact argv/cwd matched foreground worker; current agent turn remained running

cases.description: Same official CLI/model/mode with root turn still running; worker survived native Stop, heartbeat 4 to 14 bytes in five seconds. Harness terminated only the matched worker afterward.
Native Stop killed a later current-turn worker while preserving older intentional background work; older heartbeat 366 to 386 bytes, later heartbeat stayed at 4.
Inventory exposed one stoppable worker. Dedicated stop resolved, inventory became empty; actual PID absent at 0/1/3/5s, heartbeat stayed 498 bytes. Private stop token excluded.

limits: These are native CLI/client controls, not spoken cancellation.
Current 0.16 acoustic cases are recorded separately in paseo-016-voice-cases.json; these process controls do not establish spoken task cancellation.
Source review confirms turn-scoped cancellation; this does not authorize killing all older background work or claim all providers behave identically.
cleanup: Native daemons and measured workers stopped; copied official CLI auth removed. No stable service modified.
